record_title: Spectral-radius parity obstruction to ordered-product Lyapunov convergence
provenance: A source-specific correction to the spectral-radius ordered-product statistic introduced in arXiv:2609.18017v1. An explicit smooth period-two map gives exact parity oscillation of h_L despite a positive top Lyapunov exponent and spectrally stable one-step Jacobians; a singular-value block statistic provides the standard subadditive replacement.
limitations: The counterexample disproves the source paper's general convergence statement but does not show that its reported Hénon or Ikeda finite-horizon computations are wrong. The singular-value replacement measures norm growth rather than the same finite-horizon spectral quantity.
